guest_architects.configuration.title: Guest Architects
guest_architects.configuration.living_ci: Fraction of ancient cities that are still inhabited.
guest_architects.configuration.min_popul: Smallest base population of a living city.
guest_architects.configuration.max_popul: Largest base population of a living city.
guest_architects.configuration.fluctuati: Length of a fluctuating city's population cycle, in Guest years.
Relative amplitude of a fluctuating city's population cycle.
guest_architects.configuration.decline_y: Years a declining city needs to fall from full population to zero.
guest_architects.configuration.abandoned: Whether sculk keeps spreading through abandoned cities over time.
guest_architects.configuration.spread_ma: Maximum spread radius around each catalyst of an abandoned city.
guest_architects.configuration.spread_da: Days after abandonment for sculk to reach about 63% of its maximum radius.
guest_architects.configuration.max_assis: Maximum total delay player help can add to a city's decline.
guest_architects.configuration.notice_th: Interference points at which Architects stop and watch the player.
guest_architects.configuration.immobiliz: Interference points at which the player is immobilized.
guest_architects.configuration.equipment: Interference points at which the held tool is taken as a warning.
guest_architects.configuration.removal_t: Interference points at which the player is removed from the city.
guest_architects.configuration.destroy_e: Whether the warning destroys the held item; otherwise it is dropped.
guest_architects.configuration.portal_re: Whether Architects remove persistent intruders to the surface.
guest_architects.configuration.interfere: Interference points forgotten per day; faster for players who helped.
guest_architects.configuration.piglin_zo: Seconds of Overworld exposure before piglins and hoglins turn (vanilla: 15).
guest_architects.configuration.architect: Chance that a naturally spawned zombie keeps old Architect armor.
guest_architects.command.no_city: No ancient city is known in this dimension yet.
